max_iteration.comment: The maximum allowed number of iterations

min_iteration.comment: The minimum allowed number of iterations

termination_file.comment: run, which will lead to the termination of the run after the current iteration.

individual_update_stall_counter_threshol.comment: through the actOnStalls() function. A value of 0 disables this check

report_iteration.comment: The number of iterations after which a report should be issued

n_record_best_individuals.comment: Indicates how many "best" individuals should be recorded in each iteration

cp_directory.comment: The directory where checkpoint files should be stored.

cp_base_name.comment: The significant part of the checkpoint file name.

cp_overwrite.comment: When set to "true", old checkpoint files will not be kept

threshold_active.comment: Activates (1) or de-activates (0) the quality threshold

emit_termination_reason.comment: Triggers emission (1) or omission (0) of information about reasons for termination

amalgamation_likelihood.comment: rather than "just" being created through duplication schemes

size.comment: The total size of the population

n_parents.comment: The number of parents in the population

recombination_method.comment: 2: selection according to the parent's value

growth_rate.comment: Specifies the number of individuals added per iteration

sorting_method.comment: 4: MUCOMMANU mode for multiple evaluation criteria, pareto selection

step_control.comment: 3: CSA (cumulative step-size adaptation on a single global sigma) [default]

learning_rate_c.comment: The learning-rate constant c used by SELF_ADAPT_SCALED (tau = c/sqrt(2n))

recombine_sigma.comment: Whether to intermediate-recombine the per-individual sigma after recombination
